title: Abrasive Belts - Designation, Dimensions and Tolerances and Selection of Width/length Combinations
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard specifies designation, dimensions and tolerances, and selection of width/length combinations of abrasive belts in general.
clause_3_terminology: Dimensions and Tolerances and Selection of Width

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
